claim: The English has the same shape as a card in this chapter that wants に あります, and nothing tells me this one wants the です contraction instead.
evidence: Production front: 'Transport / The taxi stand is in front of the station.' (no hint) -> タクシーのりばはえきのまえです. chapter-13-extras wa-kouban-eki-mae: 'Emergencies / The police box is in front of the station.' (no hint) -> こうばんはえきのまえにあります. grammar2-2 and grammar2-3 show the deck treats the two forms as different answers: both read 'The restaurant is on the first floor.' and are split only by the hints 'using に あります ..., not the contracted です' and 'contracted with です ... instead of に あります'.
fix: Give this card the grammar2-3 hint ('contracted with です (desu) instead of に あります').

claim: The front 'Also' fits も, which I learned in Lesson 4, as well as それから, and nothing separates them.
evidence: Production front: 'Grammar & Function Words / Also' -> それから. Lesson 4 card も: 'Also, too, either (particle)'. The difference (それから joins two sentences, も sits on a noun) is only in the note on the back.
fix: Add a hint such as 'the word that starts a second sentence, not the particle'.

claim: The front 'Child' is answered by こども, which an earlier card tells me is the ordinary general word for a child.
evidence: Production front: 'Family & People / Child' -> こ (no hint). chapter-9-extras こども: '(My) child', hint 'the word for your own child, and the general word for a child', note 'こども is also the ordinary general word for "child" in any other context.'
fix: Add a hint that it is the short root used in おんなのこ／おとこのこ, e.g. 'the one-syllable word, as in girl and boy'.

claim: This chapter teaches that 'X is at Y' can be said with に あります／います or contracted to です, but only the grammar2 pair carries the hint that says which form is wanted, so the other location cards are a coin toss on Production.
evidence: Unhinted cards: ks4-smith-floor 'Smith-san is on the second floor.' -> ...にいます; fib-hanaya-tonari-byouin 'The florist is next to the hospital.' -> ...にあります; fib-tanakasan-doko-q 'Where is Tanaka-san?' -> どこにいますか; fib-tanakasan-doko-a 'He's in the president's office.' -> しゃちょうしつにいます. Each has an equally correct です form (chapter-13-extras sp-ima-doko-q: 'with a person, the place +です contraction works the same way it does for things'). Hinted cards: grammar2-2, grammar2-3.
fix: Put the grammar2-2 or grammar2-3 hint on every は-topic location card, so the front names the form.

claim: Several notes cite parts of the book I do not have, or point at a card by position, which means nothing in a shuffled deck.
evidence: osobayasan: 'softens the tone (NOTES 1)'; asoko and soko: '(the chapter teaches this with a picture, not words)'; grammar2-1: '(see GRAMMAR 2)'; grammar2-3: '(see GRAMMAR 2)'; toshokan-near-station: 'GRAMMAR 3'; grammar2-2: 'Compare also the shorter contracted version below using です.'
fix: Drop the book citations and keep the explanation; name the card instead of 'below' (e.g. 'compare レストランは1かいです').

claim: The romaji line is written differently from card to card for the same words, which makes the 'Says' line look like it is teaching a distinction that does not exist.
evidence: fib-meishi-desk-count 'roku-mai' but nanmai card 'nanmai'; fib-fork-table-count-q 'nan-bon' but nanbon card 'nanbon'; fib-fork-table-count-a 'jup-pon'; fib-kumano-chikai-a 'nijup-pun ... Basu de'; fib-kumano-chikai-q 'Kumano-jinja' but kumanojinja card 'kumano jinja'; fib-tanakasan-doko-q 'Tanaka-san' but sorekara-example 'tanaka-san'. Preflight lists only mit-tsu and san-nin here.
fix: Normalise these to the deck's romaji style (no counter hyphens, one casing rule for names).

claim: Two 'The X is next to the Y.' cards in this chapter want different endings, and neither front says which.
evidence: Production front: 'Directions / The soba shop is next to the police box.' (no hint) -> そばやはこうばんのとなりです. chapter-13 fib-hanaya-tonari-byouin: 'Shopping / The florist is next to the hospital.' (no hint) -> はなやはびょういんのとなりにあります. ex-parking-next-to-konbini: 'The parking lot is next to the convenience store.' (no hint) -> ...のとなりにあります.
fix: Give this card the 'contracted with です' hint and the にあります cards the 'using に あります' hint.

claim: 'Where is the boat dock?' wants どこですか while three same-shaped fronts in this unit want どこにありますか, with nothing to tell them apart.
evidence: Production front: 'Transport / Where is the boat dock?' -> ボートのりばはどこですか. ex-honya-doko-q 'Shopping / Where is the bookstore?' -> ほんやはどこにありますか; ex-cabinet-key-doko-q 'Where is the key to the cabinet?' -> ...どこにありますか; sp-nozomi-file-doko-q 'Where is the file for Nozomi Department Store?' -> ...どこにありますか. None has a hint.
fix: Add the 'contracted with です' hint here and the 'using に あります' hint on the three どこにありますか cards.

claim: The English is the は-topic shape ('The meeting room is ...') but the target is the が existence sentence, which this chapter's own minimal pairs teach me to translate as 'There is ...'.
evidence: Production front: 'Work & Occupations / The meeting room is next to the president's office.' -> しゃちょうしつのとなりにかいぎしつがあります. Compare ga-kouban-eki-mae 'There is a police box in front of the station.' (が) against wa-kouban-eki-mae 'The police box is in front of the station.' (は), and grammar2-1 'There is a restaurant on the first floor.' against grammar2-2 'The restaurant is on the first floor.' Following that rule I answer かいぎしつはしゃちょうしつのとなりにあります.
fix: Change the English to 'There is a meeting room next to the president's office.'

claim: Without a scene I answer with は, the way every adjective sentence since Lesson 10 has gone; the が version is only right as an answer to 'which one is good?', and the front does not say so.
evidence: Production front: 'Food / The bakery's bread is good.' (no scene) -> パンやのパンがおいしいです. The note says が 'picks out whose bread is the good one (NOTES 2)'. Lesson 10 pattern: このほんはおもしろいです. The sobaichi pair in this unit does carry scenes (td-sobaichi-ga-oishii: 'answering "この ちかくに おいしい おそばやさんが ありますか"'; wa-sobaichi-oishii: 'where the shop is already under discussion').
fix: Add a scene such as 'answering which shop's bread is good'.

claim: 'soba shop' gives me そばや (Lesson 12, and fib-sobaya-kouban-tonari in this unit) but this card wants おそばやさん, and only the word card carries the hint for the polite form.
evidence: Production front: 'Directions / Excuse me. Is there a good soba shop nearby?' -> すみません。このちかくにおいしいおそばやさんがありますか. chapter-13 osobayasan front: 'Soba shop / polite form, with the honorific お (o) in front and the …さん (san, "Mr./Ms.") ending'. fib-sobaya-kouban-tonari: 'The soba shop is next to the police box.' -> そばや...
fix: Add the osobayasan hint ('polite form, with お in front and さん at the end') to this front.

claim: The same に あります／です choice runs through this unit: only the two sobaichi location cards say which form they want, so the remaining location statements cannot be answered reliably on Production.
evidence: Unhinted, ending in に あります／います: ex-honya-doko-a 'It's next to the ramen shop.', ex-cabinet-key-doko-a 'It's in that drawer over there.', sp-nozomi-file-koko-a 'It's here. Here you go.', ex-parking-next-to-konbini, wa-kouban-eki-mae (whose own note says it 'can be shortened to こうばんは えきの まえです'), ni-keshigomu-shita, no-london-bank-file, kagi-drawer-arimasu, smith-office-imasu, sp-ima-nozomi-ni-imasu 'I'm at the Nozomi Department Store now.'. Unhinted, ending in です: wa-honya-panya-contrast. Hinted: td-sobaichi-otera-mae-ni-arimasu, td-sobaichi-otera-mae-desu.
fix: Put the 'using に あります' or 'contracted with です' hint on each of these fronts.

claim: Many notes cite the book's sections or dialogue, or point at 'the next three cards', none of which I can see while reviewing a shuffled deck.
evidence: td-sobaichi-ga-oishii, ga-panya-pan-oishii, wa-sobaichi-oishii: '(NOTES 2)'; ga-kouban-eki-mae, wa-booto-noriba-doko, sp-ima-doko-q, kagi-drawer-arimasu: '(GRAMMAR 2)'; kara-kumano-taki: '(GRAMMAR 3)'; td-sobaichi-otera-mae-ni-arimasu: 'The closing line of the dialogue says the same thing as ...'; kagi-drawer-arimasu: 'The next three cards keep every word the same'; smith-office-imasu: 'the next three cards change only that verb'.
fix: Remove the citations and position references; keep the explanation, and name the sibling cards by their Japanese.

claim: The romaji for the same word changes between this unit and the word cards it builds on.
evidence: ex-honya-doko-q and wa-honya-panya-contrast 'hon'ya' but chapter-13 honya card 'honya'; td-soba-nearby-q 'osobaya-san' but osobayasan card 'osobayasan'; kara-kumano-taki 'Kumano-jinja' but kumanojinja card 'kumano jinja'; smith-office-* 'Sumisu-san' but chapter-13 ks4-smith-floor 'sumisu-san'.
fix: Use one spelling per word, matching the word card.
